result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a faded marked crosswalk. Safety is compromised by parked vehicles near the corner which obstruct sightlines and a lack of clear traffic control signs for all approaches.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection across the side street.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corner block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk using continental or ladder patterns to increase visibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten crossing distances and prevent illegal parking near the corner.

result.summary: The environment is a residential intersection with a wide multi-lane arterial road and a smaller side street. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the lack of marked crossings or pedestrian signals across the main thoroughfare creates significant exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk across the side street is significantly faded, reducing its visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, crossing the side street on the left.

hazards.name: Wide Unprotected Crossing
hazards.description: The main arterial road has four travel lanes with no marked crossing, refuge island, or signalization, requiring pedestrians to judge gaps in multi-lane traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right side of the image, spanning the main roadway.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the side street and main road may obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of turning or approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the curb.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median refuge island on the main arterial to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.
